title: Chestnut and Mushroom Korma
description: A mild and creamy Indian-inspired stew featuring roasted chestnuts and sautéed mushrooms.
instructions: Toss the sliced chestnuts with a tablespoon of oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. Roast for 20 minutes.
In a large pan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the curry powder and dried thyme to the pan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the roasted chestnuts, vegetable broth, and chopped cilantro to the pan. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
